dataset_name: Johor Bahru Core Private Hospitals and Specialist Hospitals
licensing_authority: Ministry of Health Malaysia, Bahagian Amalan Perubatan / CKAPS
inclusion_rule: Licensed private hospital within Johor Bahru District and either emergency/A&E relevance or >=20 licensed beds with broad acute/multispecialty inpatient role.
exclusion_rule: Ordinary GP clinics, maternity-only centres, narrow specialty centres, and very small licensed inpatient facilities without verified general acute/emergency role.

emergency_evidence_grades.VERIFIED_A: Explicit/current emergency evidence from official hospital/brand/operator source or current hospital-specific evidence.
emergency_evidence_grades.VERIFIED_B: Strong 24-hour hospital/ambulance evidence but explicit current official A&E webpage not located in this audit.
